--- title: "First steps" jupyter: php --- This page assumes the `php` kernel is installed and `juphyter doctor` reports it as ready. [Installation](install.qmd) covers both. The examples were run in a Quarto document, and they behave the same way in a JupyterLab notebook. To follow along in JupyterLab, run `jupyter lab` from an environment that has it, such as `~/.venvs/juphyter/bin/jupyter lab`, and choose the PHP kernel in the launcher. To follow along in Quarto, create a file `first.qmd`: ````markdown --- title: "A first PHP document" jupyter: php --- ```{{php}} echo "sum: ", array_sum(range(1, 10)), "\n"; ``` ```` Then run `quarto render first.qmd`, which writes `first.html`. ## A first cell A cell holds PHP without an opening ` Restart Kernel**. Each `quarto render` starts a new session. ## Imports A `use` statement applies to its own cell and to every later cell. A notebook can put its imports in its first cell and use short names afterward. This example uses [phibble](https://phibble.phpstats.org), which the `php` kernel finds when the document sits inside a Composer project that requires it, or which the `phpstats` kernel from [Installation](install.qmd#the-phpstats-packages) provides. ::: {#6dd19d6d .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.php .cell-code} use Phibble\DataFrame; ``` ::: The next cell reads [sleepstudy](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#sleepstudy) from the phpstats datasets repository: reaction times in milliseconds of 18 subjects over ten days of sleep deprivation, from R's `lme4` package. ::: {#7bf36ed8 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.php .cell-code} $sleep = DataFrame::fromCsv( 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/' .'phpstats/datasets/main/csv/sleepstudy.csv' ); $sleep; ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: A cell cannot declare a `namespace`, and it cannot declare a class or a function that an earlier cell already declared. [Limitations](limitations.qmd) explains both. ## Errors A cell that throws shows the exception, its message, and a traceback whose lines name the cell and the line number. ::: {#ddf609c1 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.php .cell-code} $mean = fn (array $values) => array_sum($values) / count($values); $mean([]); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-error} ``` DivisionByZeroError: Division by zero DivisionByZeroError: Division by zero in a closure at Cell 5, line 3 ``` ::: ::: The session survives the exception. Variables defined before it keep their values. Warnings, notices, and deprecations appear in the cell's error output, and the cell keeps running. ::: {#416b45ad .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.php .cell-code} $widths = ['narrow' => 4, 'wide' => 12]; $widths['narrow'] + $widths['medium']; ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Undefined array key "medium" in Cell 6, line 3 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=6} ``` 4 ``` ::: ::: ## Rich output A phibble data frame is shown as a table and a phiz plot as a chart. The kernel sends each value in every format it can produce, and the front end picks one. [Output formats](quarto.qmd#output-formats) lists which one each Quarto format uses. Any class can provide its own output: - `toHtml(): string` supplies HTML. - `toMimeBundle(): array` supplies several formats at once, keyed by MIME type. ::: {#1b84a2f6 .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.php .cell-code} final class Progress { public function __construct(private readonly int $done, private readonly int $total) {} public function toHtml(): string { return sprintf( ' %d of %d', $this->done, $this->total, $this->done, $this->total, ); } public function __toString(): string { return sprintf('%d of %d', $this->done, $this->total); } } new Progress(7, 9); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=7} ```{=html} 7 of 9 ``` ::: ::: `Juphyter\display()` shows a value part way through a cell, so one cell can show several tables or plots. ::: {#40599153 .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.php .cell-code} Juphyter\display(new Progress(3, 9)); Juphyter\display(new Progress(9, 9)); ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} 3 of 9 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} 9 of 9 ``` ::: :::
